question: After the changelog repair, is the schema-10 migration and source-revision-first ordering contract approved as the supported upgrade path for existing stores?
rationale: The implementation is well proven, but it deliberately changes persisted schemas and state-selection semantics across several consumers, so accepting that compatibility boundary requires owner judgment rather than automation alone.

options.title: Approve after narrow repair
options.body: Remove the changelog entry and land the implementation with its existing exact-head migration and concurrency proof.

options.title: Pause for a narrower path
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers narrow or redesign the schema migration and durable ordering contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after narrow repair
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog entry and land the implementation with its existing exact-head migration and concurrency proof.
